SELECT bu.id, bu.bind_user_time AS brokerageTime, (SELECT SUM(price) FROM sales_brokerage_record r WHERE r.user_id = bu.id AND biz_type = #{bizType} AND r.status = #{status} AND r.deleted = FALSE) AS brokeragePrice, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sales_brokerage_record r WHERE r.user_id = bu.id AND biz_type = #{bizType} AND r.status = #{status} AND r.deleted = FALSE) AS brokerageOrderCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sales_brokerage_user c WHERE c.bind_user_id = bu.id AND c.deleted = FALSE) AS brokerageUserCount FROM sales_brokerage_user AS bu
bu.deleted = false
and bu.id in
#{id}
ORDER BY brokerageUserCount ASC ORDER BY brokerageUserCount DESC
ORDER BY brokerageOrderCount ASC ORDER BY brokerageOrderCount DESC
ORDER BY brokeragePrice ASC ORDER BY brokeragePrice DESC
ORDER BY bu.bind_user_time DESC
